notes: No more freeze the first time a hammer slam, bomb blast or other effect shows up: they're readied when the game starts. Most noticeable on phones and right after an update.
Controllers work in the menus: A presses the highlighted button (including Play again and Menu after a match) and B goes back.
In a party, you can't un-ready once your leader is searching for a game.
On the Mac App Store and TestFlight version, your name is your Game Center name, as on iPhone and iPad.
